column5: Medicago truncatula A17 root nodule, wild type, inoculated with Sinorhizobium meliloti 2011 wild type, replicate 1
column6: Medicago truncatula (ecotype A17) root nodule RNA-seq. Host genotype: wild type. Plants germinated on nitrogen-free Fåhraeus medium and grown in controlled-environment chambers (16 h light/8 h dark, 22 C, 55% RH, 200 umol m-2 s-1); seedlings transferred to sterile 1:1 perlite:vermiculite pots and inoculated with Sinorhizobium meliloti 2011 wild type. Root nodules harvested at 3 weeks post-inoculation. mRNA library (oligo-dT), 150 bp paired-end, DNBSEQ-T7. Library name: WT_1. Biological replicate 1.
